diagnosis: Distinct native donor shaft angles were joined using a nominal Italic angle, producing a continuous but visibly changing centerline. Long-s upper shafts show the largest mismatch.

dependencyAudit.method: Run every current Italic construction recipe while tracing the three descending arch recipes, then mark only each native outer shaft contour and compare final output recordings.

preservation.companionContours: Exact drawing recordings preserved for all independent arms, arches, bowls, and spines.
preservation.nativeLowerTerminals: Rigid horizontal translation only, checked to 0.000003 units.
preservation.baseUpperRegions: At 40 scanlines per glyph, preserve y coordinates and horizontal ink widths under only the documented upper shear, checked to 0.003 units.

boundaries: Direct native glyphs and other connected bowl/arch constructions are not normalized globally to the font post.italicAngle; their native curvature and stroke contrast remain design inputs.
